observations.note: Step 8 asks for one edit that marks all built rows, but the session made six separate edits to the plan, one per row, after a no-op edit that errored in turn 27.
After the test run moved to the background, the session polled an output file outside the workspace four times, with narration turns between, and never obtained the pass count.
The two test files ran past the 120 s foreground limit and became a background task whose output lies outside the allowed directories, so the shell could not report their result to the session.
The first plan edit had identical old and new text and errored, which cost a turn.
